title: HVAC Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for HVAC work — service call, labor, AC repair, tune-up, thermostat installation and parts. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. Labor guaranteed for 90 days; manufacturer warranty applies to parts and equipment.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled HVAC line items: service call, labor, repairs, tune-up, thermostat, parts
License # field — HVAC contractors must show it on client-facing invoices in most states
Warranty-friendly layout: separate labor and parts lines make guarantee terms easy to reference

faqs.q: What should I include on an HVAC invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and service address, a dated line-item list (service call, labor, each repair, parts), tax, and a total due. Split labor and parts so warranty terms are easy to reference.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
